For the first three years, the interest rate is 6% p.a. So, the interest paid in the first three years is:

Interest = Principal x Rate x Time
= P x 6% x 3
= 0.06P x 3
= 0.18P

For the next two years, the interest rate is 9% p.a. So, the interest paid in the next two years is:

Interest = Principal x Rate x Time
= P x 9% x 2
= 0.09P x 2
= 0.18P

For the period beyond eight years, the interest rate is 13% p.a. So, the interest paid in the period beyond eight years is:

Interest = Principal x Rate x Time
= P x 13% x (11 - 8)
= 0.13P x 3
= 0.39P

The total interest paid is the sum of the interest paid in each period:

0.18P + 0.18P + 0.39P = 8160

0.75P = 8160

Divide both sides by 0.75:

P = 10880

So, Suresh borrowed Rs.10880.

$300 - $75 = $225

Now, during the special sale, an additional 25% is deducted from the discount price. 25% of $225 is $56.25. Subtracting this from the discounted price, we get:

$225 - $56.25 = $168.75

So, the lowest possible price of the item would be $168.75.

FINAL ANSWER: C
